mission: Build the distribution + evidence-collection path: TestFlight/internal distribution preparation, consent-gated on-device evaluation telemetry with explicit silent-failure events, an upload/export path into the evaluation pipeline, the fresh-user loop runbook, and learning-curve independence tracking.
method: Added an independent evaluation_telemetry consent scope (shared-types + mobile consent API + DB scope constraint) — append-only ledger, inactive by default, separate from model_training.

Defined a shared evaluation-trial contract (packages/shared-types/src/evaluationTrial.ts): per-trial CLAIMS and abstentions only (target lock, event selection, stroke label, contact marker, phase render, result score) with structural validation; the device never asserts correctness and never ships raw video.

Wired trial capture into apps/mobile runCaptureAnalysis for every outcome (scored, quality_blocked, unavailable); trials queue in the SQLite outbox and drain via the existing sync loop to POST /v1/me/evaluation/trials.

Server route re-verifies active evaluation_telemetry consent from the ledger, validates each trial structurally, and stores append-only (trigger-protected evaluation_trial table, idempotent on trialId, cross-subject reuse rejected).

Evaluation-pipeline side (packages/swing-lab/src/freshUserTrials.ts + fresh-user:report CLI): ingest, human labels (labelerId required), explicit per-kind silent-failure counts (WRONG_TARGET, WRONG_EVENT, WRONG_STROKE, FALSE_CONTACT, IMPOSSIBLE_PHASE, FALSE_HIGH_CONFIDENCE_RESULT) with per-claim denominators — no aggregate accuracy anywhere — plus independence coverage over users/sessions/courts/devices/events with unknowns counted, never inferred.

Distribution prep: fastlane Appfile/Fastfile (TestFlight internal-only lane, credentials from env, Mac-only clearly marked), fastlane gem in the mobile Gemfile, docs/DISTRIBUTION.md signing docs, and a Linux-validatable precondition checker (apps/mobile npm run check:distribution) covering pbxproj signing settings, Info.plist usage strings/ATS/versions, privacy manifest, Podfile.lock, and no-credentials assertions.

Runbook docs/FRESH_USER_LOOP.md documents build→fresh users→failures→label/review→root cause→improve→frozen test→NEW fresh users, GATE A/B boundaries, Tier-C machine-proposal rule, and held-out case protection.

gates.root: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check — all pass
gates.mobile: npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test (41 suites, 403 tests) — all pass
gates.distribution_static: apps/mobile npm run check:distribution — 16/16 Linux-validatable preconditions pass

irreducibly_external: Mac + Xcode: pod install, archive, code signing, and TestFlight upload cannot run or be verified on Linux; the fastlane lanes are prepared but unexecuted.
Physical iPhone + real fresh users (GATE B): no on-device run, no real trial data exists; the telemetry path is exercised only by unit tests.
Qualified coach labels (GATE A): technique score / fault diagnosis / drill recommendation remain BLOCKED_ON_VALIDATION; the label schema deliberately restricts engineer labeling to mechanical claims.
Apple Developer account state (App ID, App Store Connect record, API key) is assumed, not verified.
verdict: READY_PENDING_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE: the distribution and evidence-collection path is architecturally complete and gate-green on Linux; only Mac/device execution and human evidence remain external. No coach, device, or user data was fabricated.
